enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +12: Passive: +12 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Repair Lore +12: Passive: Your Repair and Rust spells gain a 12% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Reconstruction +84: Passive: +84 Equipment bonus to Repair and Rust Spell Power.
Insightful Reconstruction +42: Passive: +42 Insight bonus to Repair and Rust Spell Power.
False Life +24: +24 Enhancement bonus to hit points.
Malleable: This item has a magical aura of malleability and can be combined with any item that has the Fusible property to create a new, more powerful fusion of the two items.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
